description: Denominator for the silent-tactic census: one minimal `by <tactic>` declaration per (tactic token, invocation shape). Tokens come from an extraction over Lean 4 v4.30.0-rc2 source (<lean4-src>/src/{Init,Lean/Elab/Tactic,Lean/Meta/Tactic,Lean/Parser,Std/Tactic}: `syntax|macro|elab ... : tactic` blocks whose LAST category marker is `tactic`, plus `@[builtin_tactic_parser]` declarations), widened with the ~54-token conv category and the Mathlib tokens Clean already registers. Invocation shapes are hand-written to match real Lean surface syntax, because a BARE token probe only reaches name lookup and misses every failure that lives in the ARGUMENT grammar -- which is where the whole silent class lived.
